legend.statisticsEligible: true iff status==completed AND runUpdatedAt <= 2026-11-21T09:40:00Z; ONLY eligible runs feed summary.statistics
legend.wallSeconds: max(co) - min(st) over jobs with both timestamps (null when not eligible)
legend.queuedSeconds: sum(max(0, st - cr)) for jobs with st
legend.worstJobQueuedSeconds: max over jobs of max(0, st - cr)
legend.admissionGateEntryQueuedSeconds: max(0, st - cr) of the workflow entry job named closure-deriver
legend.literalAdmissionCheckQueuedSeconds: max(0, st - cr) of the rollup job named admission-check (NOT a queue-latency proxy)
